title: Rabbi Avdimi, son of Rabbi Tovi’s daughter

paragraphs: Hyman cites the end of Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 6:5: Rabbi Yonatan bar Chali and Rabbi Avdimi, son of Rabbi Tovi’s daughter, in the name of Rabbi Yoshiyah.

notes.text: The frozen notice has רבי יונתן חלי. The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin6:5 has רבי יונתן בן חלי: Chali is a patronymic here, not an illness. Ben is bracketed as a proposed supplied word; no scan correction is adopted. The maternal relationship to Rabbi Tovi is explicit.

Hyman’s printed heading (vol. I, p. 60) gives the maternal relationship in full, and his quotation reads Yonatan bar Chali. The supplied Hebrew omits bar. The Guggenheimer edition and the Daat presentation labeled Vilna read Yonatan ben Chali. The Daat text explicitly connects Yonatan and Avdimi as reporting in Rabbi Yoshiyah’s name. The named passage is in Sanhedrin 6:5, with a further discussion in the same halakhah.
